name: Florin Arden
source:
Likes: Dragons
Dislikes: Anything that hurts dragons, cleaning
Hobbies: Dragon-watching, flying
Skill: Using his head

"I don't want to lose you. Not now or ever."

Clive: Florin is a dragoon of the White Dragon Knights.
He's here to investigate the magical beast transformation problem in Gedonelune.
He has a sidekick dragon named Zurvan, and he likes Zurvan very much.
Light is the name of one of the other dragoons, but it seems they're in different positions of authority.
It looks like they trust each other though.
Florin always wears a smile, is kind, and is very intelligent.
Apparently he's good at office work too.
It seems that he's different from me, and he doesn't really have anything to hide.
I think he might like dragons too much though.
It's as if he prioritizes them over everything else.
Is there anything else he's interested in...?

[Official in-game description]
